notes.title: Hot Pickle is Now FOSS
notes.notes: [p]Hi, Ben Stark here. Exciting news. Hot Pickle is now Free and Open Source Software (FOSS). The source code for Hot Pickle is already open to the public on Github. [url="https://github.com/schtink/Hot-Pickle"]Check it out.[/url] I will still be charging a fee for the compiled binaries, but the game is now open to all.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you and have a wonderful day.[/p]
